description: Resolve a place name (city, optionally with state/country) to geographic coordinates (latitude/longitude). Useful before calling air_quality, which needs lat/lon. Example: geocode({ query: "Paris", limit: 5 })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own OpenWeatherMap API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching locations to return (default 5).

query.description: Place name to look up, e.g. "Paris", "Springfield,IL,US".

name: geocode
title: Geocode
